what were the top 5 products by revenue.sql: SELECT stock_code, MAX(description) AS product_description, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE is_product = TRUE AND line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY net_revenue_gbp DESC LIMIT 5
assumptions: Revenue is calculated as net sales (sales minus returns)
Only actual products are included, excluding postage, fees, and manual adjustments
what were the top 5 products by revenue.title: Top 5 Products by Net Revenue

what was our revenue excluding cancelled.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS gross_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type = 'sale'
assumptions: Revenue excluding cancelled invoices means gross revenue from valid sales.
Postage, fees, and non-product entries are included in standard revenue calculations unless specified otherwise.
what was our revenue excluding cancelled.title: Gross Revenue (Excluding Cancelled Invoices)

which products were returned most in q3.sql: SELECT stock_code, max(description) AS product_description, SUM(-quantity) AS returned_units FROM transactions WHERE line_type = 'cancellation' AND is_product = TRUE AND invoice_date >= '2011-07-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-10-01' GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY returned_units DESC LIMIT 10
assumptions: Products returned most means the total number of units returned during the third quarter of 2011 (July to September).
Postage, fees, and non-product items are excluded.
which products were returned most in q3.title: Top Returned Products in Q3 2011

show monthly net revenue in 2011.sql: SELECT strftime(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01' AND line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
assumptions: Net revenue includes both regular sales and customer returns (cancellations)
Only includes transactions from the calendar year 2011
Money amounts are rounded to two decimal places in British pounds
show monthly net revenue in 2011.title: Monthly Net Revenue for 2011

which country generated the highest net.sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') GROUP BY country ORDER BY net_revenue_gbp DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Net revenue includes total sales minus returns and cancellations.
Unknown customers are included in the country totals.
which country generated the highest net.title: Country with Highest Net Revenue

which customers generated the most reven.sql: SELECT customer_id, country, ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation') GROUP BY customer_id, country ORDER BY net_revenue_gbp DESC LIMIT 10
assumptions: Revenue is calculated as net revenue (sales minus returns)
Customers with unknown IDs are excluded from ranking
which customers generated the most reven.title: Top Customers by Net Revenue

how many invoices were cancelled.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS cancelled_invoices_count FROM transactions WHERE is_cancelled = TRUE
assumptions: Counted unique cancelled invoice numbers across the entire period
how many invoices were cancelled.title: Total Cancelled Invoices

what was our net sales revenue in 2011.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_value), 2) AS net_sales_revenue_gbp FROM transactions WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2012-01-01' AND line_type IN ('sale', 'cancellation')
assumptions: Included all sales and customer returns for the calendar year 2011
Net revenue is calculated as total sales minus returns
what was our net sales revenue in 2011.title: Net Sales Revenue for 2011
